positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: what separates the intelligence you own and keep from the intelligence you merely rent or draw from a commodity substrate?
positions.why: Both expressions are calm, plain-spoken, aphoristic maxims (register, affect) that partition value along the same axis — src-2 opposes owned to rented intelligence, src-3 opposes commodity substrate to kept asset. Relational and power reads both land on market-pricing logic and rational-persuasion-with-inspirational-appeal rather than authority or hierarchy; value reads both as appeals to autonomy and self-enhancement through possession. Conviction differs in register — src-2 reads as a claim, src-3 as a principle — but both are asserted flatly, unhedged, as the same underlying distinction restated at two levels (capability vs. asset), so the tension between claim-level and principle-level delivery sits inside one coherent directional read rather than splitting it.
